protocol.syntheticSplit: Same stratified 60/20 holdout as the TF-IDF experiment; the 60-row training partition is split into 45/15 for threshold selection. Pretrained weights are not updated using local examples.
protocol.realRows: All 15 snapshot rows are treated as safe per user confirmation and are used only for false-positive sanity checking.
protocol.input: Title plus story text, one classifier call per story, truncated to at most 512 tokens by the pipeline.
protocol.caveat: Synthetic holdout is small and synthetic. Thresholds selected from synthetic validation may not generalize. Real safe rows provide no unsafe-class evaluation.
